---
title: "HPA Analysis"
author: "Joshua Ho"
---

The Human Protein Atlas (HPA) recorded the amount of regionally elevated genes in various species. I want to find out which species out of humans, pigs, and mice had the highest number of regionally elevated genes.

```{r}
# re stands for "regionally elevated genes"
re_human <- sum(180, 83, 57, 110)
re_pig <- sum(109, 157, 31, 45)
re_mouse <- sum(55, 185, 60, 98)
print(paste("In humans:", re_human))
print(paste("In pigs:", re_pig))
print(paste("In mice:", re_mouse))
```

Human forebrains have the most regionally elevated genes.
